task: 订单满 99 元免运费；会员折扣后金额不足 99 元时应按折后金额判断，金卡会员始终免运费。

spec_clauses.title: 运费
spec_clauses.body:
订单包邮门槛按“会员折扣后金额”判断：折后金额大于等于 99.00 元时免运费；低于
99.00 元收取 8.00 元运费。`gold` 会员始终免运费。

spec_clauses.title: 会员折扣
spec_clauses.body:
会员等级分为 `gold`、`silver`、`none`。`gold` 享受小计 10% 的折扣，`silver` 享受
5% 的折扣，`none` 不打折。折扣金额按四舍五入保留两位小数。未知会员等级应抛出
`ValueError`。

spec_clauses.title: 优惠券
spec_clauses.body:
优惠券金额在会员折扣之后扣减。扣减后应付金额不得为负数：若优惠券金额超过折后
金额，应付金额取 0。优惠券金额不得为负数。

spec_clauses.title: 订单小计
spec_clauses.body:
订单小计为所有商品行 `单价 × 数量` 之和。金额使用 Decimal 计算，并按四舍五入
（ROUND_HALF_UP）保留两位小数。商品行缺少 `unit_price` 或 `quantity` 时应抛出
`ValueError`，不得静默跳过。

spec_clauses.title: 应付总额
spec_clauses.body:
应付总额 = max(0, 小计 − 会员折扣 − 优惠券金额) + 运费。最终结果保留两位小数，
返回值包含 `subtotal`、`member_discount`、`coupon`、`shipping`、`payable` 五个字段。

code_symbols.signature: shipping(amount_before_discount: Decimal, tier: str, amount_after_discount: Decimal)
code_symbols.docstring:
Return the shipping fee for an order (S-04).

The free-shipping decision is taken from the pre-discount amount and uses a
strict comparison, so orders that only reach the threshold after a discount
are charged shipping.  ``tier`` is accepted but not yet used.

target.name: test_shipping_is_free_at_the_exact_threshold
target.docstring: Covers: S-04. A post-discount amount of exactly 99.00 qualifies for free shipping.

target.name: test_shipping_uses_the_post_discount_amount
target.docstring: Covers: S-04. A 100.00 order with a silver discount drops to 95.00 and pays shipping.

target.name: test_gold_members_always_get_free_shipping
target.docstring: Covers: S-04. Gold membership waives the shipping fee for small orders.

regression.name: test_subtotal_multiplies_unit_price_by_quantity
regression.docstring: Covers: S-01. The subtotal is the sum of all order lines.

regression.name: test_subtotal_rounds_half_up_to_cents
regression.docstring: Covers: S-01. Three-decimal prices are rounded half-up.

regression.name: test_order_line_without_price_is_rejected
regression.docstring: Covers: S-01. Incomplete order lines fail loudly instead of being skipped.

regression.name: test_gold_member_receives_ten_percent_discount
regression.docstring: Covers: S-02. Gold membership discounts the subtotal by ten percent.

regression.name: test_unknown_member_tier_is_rejected
regression.docstring: Covers: S-02. Unsupported membership levels are rejected.

regression.name: test_coupon_never_makes_the_order_negative
regression.docstring: Covers: S-03. A coupon larger than the amount due yields zero, not a credit.

regression.name: test_coupon_is_applied_after_the_member_discount
regression.docstring: Covers: S-03. The coupon is deducted from the post-discount amount.

regression.name: test_payable_is_subtotal_plus_shipping
regression.docstring: Covers: S-05. All amount fields are returned with two decimals.
